# case: ttl
## problems
## notes
fix.n.ttl-wait {"ttl":3600}
## check
z=example.com&r=is/300+www+A+198.51.100.5%5E198.51.100.5&r=is/300+@+MX+10+mail.example.com.%5E10+mail.example.com.
## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; www.example.com A
; TTL -> 300, values unchanged
www 300 IN A 198.51.100.5

; example.com MX
; TTL -> 300, values unchanged
@ 300 IN MX 10 mail.example.com.
## route53
{

  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "www.example.com.",
        "Type": "A",
        "TTL": 300,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "198.51.100.5"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "example.com.",
        "Type": "MX",
        "TTL": 300,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "10 mail.example.com"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. TTL of www.example.com A -> 300, values unchanged
#    Find the id of each record, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=A&name=www.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"ttl":300}'

# 2. TTL of example.com MX -> 300, values unchanged
#    Find the id of each record, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=MX&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"ttl":300}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
www:
  - type: A
    ttl: 300
    values:
      - '198.51.100.5'
'':
  - type: MX
    ttl: 300
    values:
      - exchange: mail.example.com.
        preference: 10
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "a_www" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "www.example.com"
  type     = "A"
  content  = "198.51.100.5"
  ttl      = 300
}

resource "cloudflare_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "MX"
  content  = "mail.example.com"
  priority = 10
  ttl      = 300
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "a_www" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "www.example.com"
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 300
  records = ["198.51.100.5"]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "MX"
  ttl     = 300
  records = ["10 mail.example.com"]
}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Change the TTL: A records
   Name: www.example.com
   New TTL: 300 seconds (the values stay the same)
2. Change the TTL: MX records
   Name: example.com
   New TTL: 300 seconds (the values stay the same)

Notes:
- Wait at least the old TTL after this change before the migration: until then resolvers may keep the longer-lived copies. A resolver still had one for 3600 s; the zone’s own value can be higher.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is/300+www+A+198.51.100.5%5E198.51.100.5&r=is/300+@+MX+10+mail.example.com.%5E10+mail.example.com.
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. TTL’i değiştir: A kayıtları
   Ad: www.example.com
   Yeni TTL: 300 saniye (değerler aynı kalır)
2. TTL’i değiştir: MX kayıtları
   Ad: example.com
   Yeni TTL: 300 saniye (değerler aynı kalır)

Notlar:
- Bu değişiklikten sonra taşımadan önce en az eski TTL kadar bekleyin: o zamana kadar çözümleyiciler uzun ömürlü kopyaları tutabilir. Bir çözümleyicide 3600 sn kalmış bir kopya vardı; zone’daki asıl değer daha yüksek olabilir.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is/300+www+A+198.51.100.5%5E198.51.100.5&r=is/300+@+MX+10+mail.example.com.%5E10+mail.example.com.
